_about: ⛺ Spawn camp check (hidden build-log only, owner t704–t713). sessions: Honu PC sessions read kill by kill; sample = random 60+ kill PC session (worlds 1 + 10) used to measure the bar. stats = measured from the sample, rebuilt by scripts/spawn-camp.mjs. Review hint only: never public, never hides anyone.
rule: PC sessions with ≥ 60 kills whose spawn-kill share (kills with no matching kill XP within 2 s) is at or above the top-10% bar of a random PC sample (now 5.4%, median 2.4%, 199 sessions). Left out: confirmed stat padders, and sessions where the top 2 victims take 50%+ of 5+ spawn kills (padding pattern).
